subtitle.zh: Local text-to-image with SenseNova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT (native unified multimodal, 11 trained resolution buckets, up to native 4K), running offline on one 24GB GPU via layer offloading of the 32.66GB weights.
subtitle.en: Local text-to-image with SenseNova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT (native unified multimodal, 11 trained resolution buckets, up to native 4K), running offline on one 24GB GPU via layer offloading of the 32.66GB weights.

notes.zh: MTNode starts/stops the local HTTP service on port 8774: /health /generate /progress /cancel /shutdown. The PNG (plus optional .think.txt and settings.json) is written into the caller-provided outputDir. Weights are ~32.66GB (ModelScope first) and do not fit 24GB VRAM in bf16, so fast layer offloading is the default.
